intro.text: Matron of Pashadon Hall, a women's dormitory at Elendel University.

items.text: Wayne had to get past her every month when he brought Allriandre her stipend. Considering him a scoundrel, she had told him to stop coming because he upset Allriandre. Once, looking ready to fight him, she let him in after he bribed her with tickets to Lady ZoBell's party stolen from Wax and Steris, and warned Allriandre he was drunk.

appearance.text: Wayne describes her as built like an ox, with hair curling like horns. She wears a small hat to keep up with Elendel fashion.

personality.text: Stern, hard to intimidate and keen to count herself part of Elendel's upper society. Wayne calls her the "Tyrant of Pashadon".
